A '''battle''' was a battle of the [[Jedi Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]]. At the [[Daalang system/Legends|Daalang system]], the two sides fought with the Sith emerging as the victors. Daalang was then held by the Sith Empire as part of its territory.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was referenced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EA" /> An exact date is not provided for the battle, and it only illustrates the battle on the galactic map rather than describe it in prose.<ref name="EA" />
